summary.text: Hunter Smith is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 24, has served since 2024, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a business owner and former NFL punter.

paragraphs.text: Hunter Smith was born in Sherman, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame.
His career experience includes owning and operating WonderTree Farm and playing as an NFL punter for the Indianapolis Colts and Washington Redskins.
Smith assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Donna Schaibley, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Democrat Racheal Bleicher.
For 2025-2026, he was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Development, Education, and House Environmental Affairs committees.
